sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hová*? asks where someone is going. Use a destination form with movement verbs such as *megy* and jön.

items.english: Károly is going to the shop.

sections.content: If you picture Károly restlessly wandering off to the shop mid-conversation, that’s exactly the scene Hová megy Károly? is asking about — Hungarian has a dedicated question word just for catching people in the act of going somewhere.
